record.title: SEC Regulation Crypto Assets
record.sub: Securities and Exchange Commission · latest step: August 21, 2026
record.text: Set up a federal way to raise money through crypto investment contracts: two offering exemptions and a later safe harbor once the issuer's promised work on the network is finished or stops, with disclosure rules and limits on retail participation.
kv: A Commission proposal (Release 33-11434, file S7-2026-27), published in the Federal Register on August 21, 2026. Comments are due October 20, 2026. Not final.
open: Whether the SEC extends the October 20 comment deadline.
